current_suggestion.pitch: You're getting GTO theory from Wizard and GTO Lab, but Garrett covers the live high-stakes psychology layer that purely solver-driven content misses — reads, table dynamics, mental game at the highest cash game levels, and how to think under real pressure when GTO is only part of the equation. He posts hand breakdowns and direct commentary on live play decisions that complement rather than duplicate what solver-focused channels produce. Format is solo analysis and conversational, with the introspective depth of someone who has played millions at stake and thought seriously about the mental side of the game.
